function.description: For an explicit NEW side discussion with additional work there. Prefer before evidence work; refused after attempted changes. Reporting an already calculated result still counts: quote that remaining task verbatim, work=answer. Branch-only requests use start_thread. Never infer work from titles/history. Continues once, without acceptance or a business scenario.
function.name: start_thread_and_continue

task.description: The exact verbatim span of the current user request specifying additional work, such as calculate the difference between 14.80 and 12.40. Exclude the branching instruction. Never invent or paraphrase a task or take it from earlier messages. Required.

work.description: Remaining operation: answer for research/calculation/reporting; propose_movement for inventory; propose_record for other Records; propose_table for new data; propose_table_edit for existing values; draft for documents; save_space for NEW views; edit_space for existing views; restore_space for a selected version. A title alone requests no space/table.

function.description: Create a NEW side discussion and STOP for branch-only requests. Additional comparison, calculation, drafting or reporting requires start_thread_and_continue, preferably first. A calculated result is not a delivered answer. Never use for rename, return, review or hypothetical explanations. Clarify unavailable targets. No business scenario.
function.name: start_thread

message.description: Omit to keep the latest exchange including its answer. Supply an exact earlier message ID only when the user explicitly selects that earlier exchange in this conversation.

function.description: Rename the open side discussion only, when requested. Other targets require opening first; never create a replacement or redundantly rename to stay put. Ends turn.
function.name: rename_current_thread

function.description: Return from the current side discussion to main when explicitly requested. Does not copy or share findings. Ends this turn; the owning window applies navigation.
function.name: return_to_main

function.description: Prepare this side discussion’s findings for editable review before sharing with main, including wording-review requests. No publication or new thread. Ends turn.
function.name: review_thread_summary

message.description: Omit for the latest completed answer. Use an exact earlier message ID only for a user-selected exchange in this thread.

summary.description: Optional selected findings to review. Omit to review the original answer. Preserve uncertainty; nothing is shared until the user reviews and confirms.

function.description: Search older original messages in this conversation. History is not new action authority. Use when recent context is insufficient.
function.name: history_search

function.description: Read an original in this conversation or explicit parent excerpt only. Refresh evidence/acceptance before historical business claims.
function.name: history_read

function.description: Page saved receiptID fields via path/nextOffset. Refresh old evidence before citation.
function.name: tool_result

rawJSON.description: Serialized JSON text segments; use empty path.

function.description: Draft an evidence-based table,40columns/100rows. Acceptance separate; preserve meaning, including estimates/plans.
function.name: propose_table

formula.description: Optional deterministic formula referring to column IDs.

items.description: Column IDs mapped to values; decimals are strings. Never invent missing facts.

function.description: List ZIP file members without extracting them. Requires an existing archive source ID.
function.name: archive_members

function.description: Unpack requested ZIP members only. Preserve original/member lineage; retries resume. Never automatically recurse.
function.name: include_archive_members

items.description: Exact member path returned by archive_members.

function.description: Search business evidence (itemID) and conversation (id; history_read before citation). Filters/paging are business-only. No match proves no absence.
function.name: search

function.description: Follow saved mentions, one hop,12/page: incoming mentions or outgoing destinations. Read originals before citing. Mentions grant no authority, lineage, business relationship or cross-scope access. Empty proves no absence.
function.name: references

contentScope.description: Default all: saved body plus retained extracted-text mentions.

direction.description: Default outgoing. Use incoming for where an item is mentioned.

historicalOrigins.description: Incoming: include earlier origin versions only when needed; default false.

targetScope.description: Incoming scope: logical by default; exact restricts target versions.

function.description: Count classified Sources/Records only when asked. Never inventory units, document facts or real events. Unneeded for balances/citations. finish.counts renders its exact scoped receiptID.
function.name: count_records

function.description: Read exact evidence, bounded chunks and saved references. Follow references.hits: corrected bindings can differ from raw URIs. Read destinations before citing; page via references. Earlier request Sources require scoped history_read.
function.name: read

chunkLimit.description: Default two. Follow chunkPage.nextOffset; partial pages are incomplete.

copyOffset.description: documentCopies.nextOffset; retain chunk offset/limit while paging copies.

function.description: Trace the evidence and derived records around an item.
function.name: lineage

function.description: List workbook tables with IDs, columns and row counts.
function.name: datasets

function.description: Read up to 100 table rows with deterministic formula results.
function.name: rows

function.description: Compare table values deterministically: minimum, maximum, difference and percentage cheaper relative to the maximum. Use for supplier cost comparisons instead of mental arithmetic.
function.name: compare_rows

valueColumn.description: Numeric or calculated column to compare.

function.description: List current drafts, oldest first, 20/page via nextCursor. Excludes requests/rows; edits appear as table proposals. Titles/IDs are discovery: read originals before claims.
function.name: review_queue

function.description: Open pending drafts in the live window when requested. Host confirms navigation; no acceptance/withdrawal. Not for conceptual explanations.
function.name: open_reviews

function.description: Open a requested existing space by exact name/ID. Use visible active ID for this space; clarify ambiguity. Host confirms navigation. Not for explanations or creation.
function.name: open_space

function.description: Pin/unpin a requested existing navigation shortcut. Use active space ID for this space; clarify ambiguity. Does not freeze/copy values.
function.name: set_space_pinned

function.description: Create a requested frozen space snapshot with exact values/inputs, max 1,000 rows/table. Navigation shortcuts use set_space_pinned.
function.name: pin_space

function.description: Draft cell changes for human review: read exact rows first; supply their version IDs and changed fields only. Accepted values stay unchanged.
function.name: propose_table_edit

values.description: Changed column IDs mapped to new values. Decimal values are strings.

function.description: Deterministic decimal arithmetic. Use for arithmetic claims.
function.name: calculate

expression.description: Arithmetic expression, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVERAGE, COUNT, IF or ROUND.

function.description: Calculate accepted actual stock from an opening basis and unique events.
function.name: balance

function.description: List saved native spaces.
function.name: spaces

function.description: Inspect bounded saved layout versions. Does not restore or alter data.
function.name: space_history

beforeVersion.description: Exclusive earlier version for paging; omit initially.

function.description: Edit an existing space or Home when requested. Read spaces for exact IDs/version. Preserve unrelated components. Stale bases refuse. Changes layout only. Move/insert requires at:first, at:last, or beforeID; omit unrelated fields.
function.name: edit_space

at.description: Required for insert/move unless beforeID. Use last to append.

beforeID.description: Move/insert before this ID in the same group, instead of at.

componentID.description: Existing stable component ID for all operations except rename or insert.

operation.description: insert/move MUST include at or beforeID.

function.description: Restore a requested layout version after inspecting space_history/current space. Keep history/data; stale bases refuse.
function.name: restore_space

function.description: Create a NEW space; Home/existing changes use spaces then edit_space. Each table/chart requires datasetID. Confirm only successful receipts.
function.name: save_space

function.description: Save a draft. Exact labels, quantities or wording use parts with documentCopies IDs; never retype. Combine copies with new prose. text is for new summaries/paraphrases. Saving proves no completeness.
function.name: draft

parts.description: Use parts OR text. Each part: text for new prose OR copy for an exact passage ID inserted by the host.

copy.description: Exact passage ID from documentCopies.entries. The host supplies its original text and lineage.

function.description: Propose a draft interpretation. It does not accept a business event.
function.name: propose_record

function.description: Draft inventory movement only when evidence/current request establishes direction relative to our stock. Receipt/delivery/handover alone is ambiguous: ask first. Acceptance is separate.
function.name: propose_movement

occurrence.description: Business occurrence ID; reusing it cannot duplicate its effect.

quantity.description: Signed decimal: positive adds to our stock; negative leaves our stock.

supersedes.description: Correction: exact current movement version. Keep subject/occurrence; never bypass duplicates with a new occurrence.

function.description: Deliver the answer with its basis. Business/history facts require evidence and inspected citations, even if summaries/host state suggest them. Explain missing/partial evidence and failed actions.
function.name: finish

answer.description: Plain-language answer. Do not print opaque IDs in prose.

basis.description: evidence: workbook/history facts with inspected citations. current_request: this request's supplied facts/checked arithmetic. completed_action: successful current-run action only. preview: host renders an unsaved action preview. general: guidance/greeting/clarification/verified UI; no business/history facts. unresolved: cannot establish facts; no guessing.

items.description: Inspected item version ID, or message:ID returned by history_read for a statement about earlier conversation.
Current-run count_records receipts for requested entry counts only. Not inventory quantities, calculations, search or historical receipts. Host renders exact count/scope.

function.description: Find behavior metadata, never evidence/authority. Empty query lists.
function.name: find_definitions

query.description: Words in saved behavior; empty lists.

function.description: Inspect behavior/dependencies. Metadata grants no authority. Fill nativeComponent’s typed arguments.
function.name: read_definition

function.description: Trusted primitives/formats; no execution.
function.name: definition_registry

function.description: Receiving template. Use save_template with receiptID; never retype.
function.name: receiving_template

function.description: Current action’s form template. Save receiptID; never retype.
function.name: form_template

function.description: Read-only function/query. Page with same arguments; preserve meaning/scope/coverage. Aggregates need originals.
function.name: evaluate_definition

arguments.description: Decimal strings; omission differs from null.

function.description: Publish complete current-run evaluation as draft with lineage. Stale/partial refuses; acceptance separate.
function.name: publish_result

evaluationReceiptID.description: This run’s successful first-page evaluation receiptID.

function.description: Save behavior, no execution/acceptance. New: omit IDs; edits need both. Templates: save_template.
function.name: save_definition

function.description: Copy this run’s template. No execution/acceptance. Edits need both IDs.
function.name: save_template

function.description: Preview inspected action/form, no effects. Clarify missing facts. Returns plan/receiptID.
function.name: preview_action

arguments.description: Decimal strings, exact item IDs; no invented facts.

function.description: Prepare drafts, never accept. Host previews action/form and checks directions before atomic save. Unsaved plan: preview_action.
function.name: prepare_action

arguments.description: Declared typed inputs; no invented facts.
